description: Runs any read-only contract call (eth_call) with your own calldata and returns the raw result, on five chains, with no API key and no rate limit. The escape hatch for anything the typed endpoints do not cover. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

block.description: Block tag or number. Defaults to latest.

from.description: Optional caller address, for calls that check msg.sender.
